payload.title: Adjudicate data items keyed on source field names
payload.description:
Adjudicate data-item gold keyed on source field names rather than concepts.

Measured: 308 of 436 data-item annotations match no rule under any alias, because gold recorded the **source field name**: `id` x17, `name` x8, `token` x7, `location` x5, `city` x5, `status` x3, `key` x3, `uid` x3, `pass` x3, `uuid` x3, `card_reference` x3, and a long tail.

Each needs a canonical concept leaf assigned, or an explicit no-concept adjudication recording that the corpus asserts a source field with no inferable concept. This is the largest single block of human judgement in the programme and it gates the first baseline: with 15 rules, data-item recall is capped near 29% until it is resolved.

Filed as an `annotation` issue so it runs the flywheel ladder — labeling, awaiting-review, accepted — rather than being closed by whoever wrote it. Requires `annotations/<id>/pass.md` before it can advance.
